title: Manuel Academy Social Studies R3 production envelope
description: The production-only fields an R3 lesson carries in addition to the shared lesson model. A complete R3 production lesson satisfies social-studies-lesson-model.schema.json AND this schema AND the rhythm rule in promotion-rules.json. The envelope is deliberately separate: the model is shared with the frozen Director-approved R2 samples and must not acquire production fields, and the samples must not silently pass as production content.

sampleStatus.description: A production lesson is not a Director sample. The sample marker must be removed by promotion, never carried forward.

productionStatus.description: Lifecycle state. Only PRODUCTION_ADMITTED may be referenced by an admission manifest.

provenance.description: Pins the approved model this lesson was built against, so a later change to the frozen approval is detectable rather than silent.

modelSampleId.description: The Social Studies R2 sample whose grade band and rhythm this lesson follows.

runtimeReadiness.description: Reuses the existing final Social Studies package vocabulary. PENDING_SOURCE_ATTACHMENT keeps launch and scoring disabled until an adult attaches qualifying evidence; it does not make the course unready.

sourceReview.description: A recorded human source review. The R2 bar was every excerpt, title, date, and repository checked against the real record; production cannot rely on that being done informally.

reviewedByRole.description: PENDING_HUMAN_SOURCE_REVIEW is honest for a lesson whose sources are carried by the repository's verified registry but which no human has yet signed off. The verifier rejects it for PRODUCTION_ADMITTED.

verifiedAgainst.description: The repositories or official records each excerpt, title, date, and citation was checked against.

noInventedQuoteTitleOrUrl.description: No quotation, title, creator, date, or URL in this lesson was invented, and no words are attributed to a real person they did not say.

simulatedEvidenceLabeled.description: Every simulated dossier, fictional dataset, or paraphrase is labeled as such in the learner-visible text.

lessonReview.description: Presence is required for production; the shape is validated by the model schema. A Director sample may omit it, which is one of the documented gate findings.

courseProgress.description: Real course position. Director samples state that they award no course credit; a production lesson states its actual day, and the rhythm rule checks it against the lesson reference.
